task_profile: NUI repository v1 implementation plan: universal skill graph, deterministic validator, adapters, research ledger and eval contracts
claim: The NUI v1 repository satisfies its declared structural, skill-contract, adapter, eval-contract, and deterministic completion-gate checks when this packet is accepted by the same commit's CI verification workflow.
bounds: This packet verifies repository and skill-system invariants, not the beauty or usability of every UI a future model may generate.
Agent-behavior pressure cases are specifications for runtime evaluation; their presence and JSON validity are not reported as live cross-model benchmark passes.
Accessibility and fidelity of any product UI require task-specific normative/runtime evidence through NUI's own obligation and evidence process.
No claim is made that NUI objectively outperforms every competing UI skill until controlled head-to-head agent evaluations are executed.
unknowns: Cross-model repeated behavior-eval scores have not been produced by repository-only CI.
Runtime-specific browser, screenshot, semantic-tree, and subagent quality varies by the host environment.
